name: AutoLife S3
summary: AutoLife S3 is a wheeled humanoid platform for indoor reception, retail, dining and supermarket tasks. A height-adjustable body, articulated arms and dexterous hands support object handling and handover, while stereo vision, LiDAR and inertial sensing support navigation in assessed environments. The manufacturer describes training manipulation skills from demonstrations and simulation. The S3 is presented for project consultation; exact-model commercial delivery status is not independently established.
